description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lightology is hiring a PHP Full-Stack Developer to develop front-end and back-end components for its custom websites and web applications. The role involves work across all stages of web application development.
PHP full-stack developer building front-end and back-end websites and web applications

Responsibilities:
• Ideal candidate will be involved in all stages of front-end and back-end component development for our own custom websites and web applications

Requirements:
• superb programming, database, and web application development skills
• A strong web development and object-oriented programming background
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, information technology, or a related field
• Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Experience with at least one front-end framework (e.g. jQuery, React, Vue.js)
• Experience with at least one back-end language (e.g. PHP, Python, Java)
• Experience with relational databases (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL)
• Experience with Bootstrap, SASS, and responsive design
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
• Strong problem-solving skills

Preferred:
• 1-2 years of experience with web development is a plus
• Experience collaborating in a development team is a plus
• Experience with version control (e.g. Git, SVN) is a plus
